# Claudealyzer 0.2.0

A big update: find anything in your history, see where a project's money goes over time, and get warned before
you run over a budget or a usage limit. OpenCode is now supported.

## What's new

- **Search every transcript.** Press <kbd>⌘K</kbd> (<kbd>Ctrl+K</kbd>) to search prompts, answers, shell commands,
  file paths and tool calls across all sessions. Use `"quotes"` for a phrase, narrow it to one kind or the current
  project, and click a hit to jump to that turn or command.
- **OpenCode support.** Reads `opencode.db` (both table layouts) and the older `storage/` folders, read-only.
  Sessions started by the task tool show up as subagents, and OpenCode's own cost total is shown next to the estimate.
- **Model and date filters.** Two new pickers in the title bar narrow the project tree, Overview, the dashboards,
  Compare, Trends and Search together.
- **Export.** A session as Markdown or JSON (or Markdown straight to the clipboard), sessions as CSV, daily usage as CSV.
  From the File menu (<kbd>⌘E</kbd>, <kbd>⇧⌘E</kbd>), the title bar, Overview, Calendar and the sidebar's context menus.
- **Project dashboard** (<kbd>⌘6</kbd>). Cost over time by day or week, the most expensive sessions, most-edited files,
  recurring findings and cost per model.
- **Compare** (<kbd>⌘7</kbd>). Two sessions side by side, or two periods (this week vs last week, this month vs last
  month, or your own ranges), with every change marked better or worse.
- **Insight trends** (<kbd>⌘8</kbd>). Week by week, how often each rule fires and what it costs, so you can see whether
  acting on the suggestions helps.
- **Budgets & limits** (<kbd>⌘9</kbd>).
  - Daily, weekly and monthly budgets for everything, one source or one project, with a projection to the end of the period.
  - Subscription 5-hour windows and weeks rebuilt from your history, with optional limits you set per source.
  - Alerts when a budget or limit gets close or runs out, or when one session passes a cost you choose: in the app,
    and optionally as system notifications.

## Under the hood

- Session summaries now keep hourly cost, findings per rule and edited files. The summary cache is rebuilt once on
  the first start, which takes a few seconds.
- The agent filter in the title bar is now a menu, to make room for the new filters.
- Still local only: alerts and notifications are worked out on your machine, and nothing is sent anywhere.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `claudealyzer-macos-arm64.zip` |
| macOS, Intel | `claudealyzer-macos-amd64.zip` |
| Windows x64 | `claudealyzer-windows-amd64.exe` |
| Linux x64 | `claudealyzer-linux-amd64` |

Install notes are unchanged from
[0.1.0](https://github.com/molnarroland/Claudealyzer/releases/tag/v0.1.0#before-you-run-it).
System notifications on macOS need the app to be a signed `.app`; in other builds alerts show inside the app only.

**Full changelog:** [v0.1.1...v0.2.0](https://github.com/molnarroland/Claudealyzer/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0)
